diagram_math_checks.objects_and_maps: L=O_X(-E)|_E is the conormal line bundle; L dual=O_X(E)|_E is the normal line bundle. The lower arrow labelled take the dual denotes the operation of dualizing, not an asserted sheaf homomorphism L→L dual.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: Step 1.1 establishes E effective Cartier, so its ideal is invertible and its conormal is that ideal restricted to E. Tensor inverse line bundles give the displayed dual relation.
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Proof 1.1 and 3.1; local restriction-degree supplier Facts F1 and its invertible-ideal identity.
